title: Kogin da Ya Bayyana Zukata
intro: Ka yi tunanin rundunar sojoji a kan tafiya, suna jin ƙishirwa kuma an gwada su, inda umarni ɗaya a bakin kogi zai raba ƙuduri da sha'awa. Shugaba da aka zaɓa zai jagoranci sahun zuwa ga babban maƙiyi, yana ɗauke da aminci ga Allah kaɗai.
clues: Allah ya naɗa ni a matsayin shugaba a kan Bani Isra'ila bayan sun nemi ɗaya da zai yi yaƙi a hanyarsa.
An ba ni yalwar ilimi da girma a matsayin alamar zaɓena, kodayake mutanena suna shakkar ikona.
Na fita tare da rundunonin na ce musu Allah zai jarrabe su da kogi.
Na yi gargaɗin cewa duk wanda ya sha daga ciki ba zai zama nawa ba, sai wanda ya ci ɗan kaɗan.
Na yi karo da 'yan kaɗan da suka tsaya tsayin daka, ina fuskantar rundunar da ta fi yawa.
Na jagoranci waɗanda suka ce sau nawa ƙaramin kamfani ke cin nasara a kan babban kamfani da izinin Allah, kafin a kayar da Jalut.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ana jefa shi cikin wuta mai sanyi
Barci a cikin kogo tsawon shekaru da yawa
Gwada rundunar da kogi kafin yaƙi
trial.answer: Gwada rundunar da kogi kafin yaƙi

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Canzawa zuwa birrai don aikata laifi
Nasara da izinin Allah kuma Dawud ya kashe Jalut
Nutsewa cikin teku tare da masu masaukin baki
outcome.answer: Nasara da izinin Allah kuma Dawud ya kashe Jalut

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
